title: search: date parsing failure returns epoch timestamp, ambiguous with 1970 articles
description: Lines 83-112 in crates/reader/src/search/mod.rs return timestamp 0 when date parsing fails. But 0 represents 1970-01-01 UTC, a real date. Articles with invalid date headers are indexed with this timestamp and may be confused with articles actually from 1970 if sorting/filtering by date. Should use a sentinel value (e.g., u64::MAX, or store is_date_valid flag) to distinguish parse failures from real dates.
